name: 六级扩展
words: proximately
adv. 近似，接近
The two incidents occurred proximately in time, suggesting they were closely linked.
这两起事件在时间上发生得很接近，表明它们密切相关。
wildfire
n. 野火
The wildfire spread quickly across the dry hills, forcing many families to leave their homes.
野火迅速蔓延过干燥的山丘，迫使许多家庭离开家园。
compact
adj. 紧凑的，小巧的；坚实的 vt. 把…压实，使坚实 n. 契约，合同
This compact camera fits easily into my pocket and is perfect for travel.
这款小巧的相机很容易放进口袋，非常适合旅行。
defy
vt. 违抗，蔑视；使成为不可能；惹，激
The young athlete chose to defy his coach's advice and changed his training plan.
这名年轻运动员选择违抗教练的建议，改变了自己的训练计划。
server
n. 服务器
The server brought our drinks quickly and smiled at everyone at the table.
服务员很快端来了我们的饮料，并对桌旁的每个人微笑。
rustle
v. 发出沙沙声
I heard a soft rustle of leaves as the wind moved through the trees.
当风吹过树林时，我听到树叶轻柔的沙沙声。
diversion
n. 转移，转向；消遣，娱乐；临时绕行路
The new park offers a welcome diversion for families living in the crowded city.
这座新公园为住在拥挤城市里的家庭提供了一个令人愉快的消遣场所。
merge
v. 结合，合并，合为一体
Small firms often merge to survive in competitive markets.
小公司常常合并以在竞争激烈的市场中生存。
priceless
adj. 无价的，难以用价格衡量的
The look on her face when she opened the gift was priceless.
她打开礼物时脸上的表情是无价的。
honorary
adj. 荣誉的
The university gave him an honorary degree for his lifelong contributions to science.
大学授予他荣誉学位，以表彰他毕生对科学做出的贡献。
chronic
adj. 慢性的，久病的；长久的，不断的；积习难改的
She has suffered from chronic back pain for more than ten years.
她患慢性背痛已经十多年了。
inexhaustible
adj. 用不完的，无穷无尽的
Her energy for helping students seemed inexhaustible, even after a long day of teaching.
她帮助学生的精力似乎取之不尽，即使教了一整天课之后也是如此。
contamination
n. 污染
The factory was fined for the contamination of the nearby river with harmful chemicals.
这家工厂因有害化学物质污染附近的河流而被罚款。
imminent
adj. 即将来临的
An economic crisis appears imminent without policy changes.
若不改变政策，经济危机似乎迫在眉睫。
obesity
n. 过度肥胖
Doctors warn that childhood obesity can lead to serious health problems later in life.
医生警告说，儿童肥胖会在日后导致严重的健康问题。
incorporate
vt. 包含；加上，吸收；把…合并，使并入
The firm will incorporate the new unit into its structure.
公司将把新部门并入其架构。
irrational
adj. 不合理的，不理性的
His fear of math seems completely irrational.
他对数学的恐惧似乎完全不合理的。
inherent
adj. 内在的；固有的，生来就有的
Every job has its inherent risks, so workers must be trained carefully before starting.
每份工作都有其固有的风险，因此员工在开始工作前必须接受认真培训。
overexcited
adj. 过于激烈的
The children were so overexcited about the trip that they could hardly sleep.
孩子们对这次旅行太过兴奋，几乎睡不着觉。
exotic
adj. 外来的，异国情调的；奇异的
The garden contains many exotic plants from tropical regions.
这个花园里有许多来自热带地区的外来植物。
stockbroker
n. 股票经理人
The stockbroker advised his clients to sell shares before the market crashed.
股市崩盘前，这位股票经纪人建议客户卖出股票。
misinterpret
v. 误解
Students often misinterpret the question and lose points on the exam.
学生常常误解题目，因而在考试中失分。
outdated
adj. 过时的
This textbook is outdated and needs replacing.
这本教科书过时了，需要更换。
outnumber
v. 超过
In many large lectures, female students clearly outnumber male students in the classroom.
在许多大型讲座中，女生的人数明显超过课堂上的男生。
supervisor
n. 督导
My supervisor asked me to finish the report before Friday.
我的导师要求我在周五之前完成报告。
fluctuate
vi. 波动，涨落，起伏
Oil prices fluctuate with global demand.
油价随全球需求而波动。
markedly
adv. 显著地
Her test scores improved markedly after she changed her study habits.
她改变了学习习惯后，考试成绩显著提高。
ineffective
adj. 无效的
The old teaching method proved ineffective, so the school adopted a new approach.
旧的教学方法被证明效果不佳，因此学校采用了一种新方法。
bleak
adj. 荒凉的
The future looked bleak for the small company after it lost its biggest customer.
这家小公司在失去最大的客户后，前景看起来十分黯淡。
foster
adj. 收养的 vt. 收养，养育；培养，促进
Teachers should foster curiosity in students rather than just test their memory.
教师应当培养学生的好奇心，而不只是考查他们的记忆力。
misfortune
n. 不幸，厄运，逆境；不幸事故，灾难，灾祸
The family suffered great misfortune after the flood.
洪水过后，这家人遭受了巨大的不幸。
citation
n. 引文
The professor added a citation to support his argument in the research paper.
教授在论文中添加了一条引文来支持他的论点。
rape
n&vt. 强奸
The law punishes those who commit rape severely.
法律严惩实施强奸者。
ecological
adj. 生态学的
Cutting down forests on a large scale causes serious ecological damage.
大规模砍伐森林会造成严重的生态破坏。
cornerstone
n. 基石
Trust is the cornerstone of any friendship.
信任是任何友谊的基石。
prematurely
adv. 早熟地，过早地
The researchers warned that publishing the results prematurely could damage their reputation.
研究人员警告说，过早发表研究结果可能会损害他们的声誉。
dilute
adj. 稀释的，冲淡的 vt. 稀释，冲淡
Factories must not dilute waste water before discharge.
工厂不得在排放前稀释废水。
stray
vi. 走失，迷路；分心，走神；离题 adj. 迷路的，走失的；孤立的，零星的 n. 走失的家畜
The lost dog strayed far from home.
那只走失的狗偏离家很远。
imbalance
n. 不平衡
The imbalance between work and family life often causes serious stress for young employees.
工作与家庭生活之间的不平衡常常给年轻员工带来严重的压力。
affiliation
n. 隶属关系，单位团体
Her affiliation with the research center helped her find a job after graduation.
她与研究中心的隶属关系帮助她在毕业后找到了一份工作。
counterpart
n. 与对方地位相当的人，与另一方作用相当的物
The young engineer earns much less than her counterpart in the foreign company.
这位年轻工程师的收入远低于她在外国公司的同行。
demonstration
n. 展示；游行
The teacher gave a simple demonstration of the experiment before the students tried it.
老师在学生尝试之前对这个实验做了简单的演示。
outlive
v. 比……活的时间长
Some old traditions can outlive the people who first created them.
有些古老的传统会比最初创造它们的人存续得更久。
revolutionize
v. 革命化
The new technology may revolutionize the way students learn foreign languages.
这项新技术可能会彻底改变学生学习外语的方式。
outweigh
v. 超过
The benefits of regular exercise far outweigh the risks of injury.
定期锻炼的好处远远超过受伤的风险。
documentary
adj. 纪录的；文献的
We watched a documentary about climate change in our geography class yesterday.
我们昨天在地理课上观看了一部关于气候变化的纪录片。
unintentionally
adv. 无意地
She unintentionally offended her colleague by forgetting to invite him to the meeting.
她因为忘记邀请那位同事参加会议而无意中冒犯了他。
opposition
n. 反对
The new policy faced strong opposition from local residents who feared losing their homes.
这项新政策遭到了当地居民的强烈反对，他们担心会失去自己的家园。
polar
adj. 地极的，近地极的；磁极的；正好相反的，截然对立的
The polar ice caps are melting faster than scientists expected.
极地冰盖正在以比科学家预期更快的速度融化。
integral
adj. 构成整体所必需的，基本的
The team must remain integral to achieve the goal.
团队必须保持完整才能实现目标。
affiliate
vt. 使隶属于 n. 附属机构，分公司
Our university is affiliated with several hospitals where students receive practical training.
我们大学附属有几家医院，学生在这些医院接受实践培训。
irrigation
n. 灌溉；（医）冲洗法
Modern farmers rely on irrigation to grow crops during dry seasons.
现代农民依靠灌溉在干旱季节种植农作物。
memorable
adj. 值得纪念的
The trip to the mountains was so memorable that we still talk about it.
那次去山区的旅行令人如此难忘，以至于我们至今还在谈论它。
decisive
adj. 决定性的；坚定的，果断的，决断的
Her decisive action during the emergency saved everyone in the building.
她在紧急情况下的果断行动救了楼里的每一个人。
displace
vt. 取代，替代；迫使…离开家园，使离开原位
Coal is to be displaced by clean energy.
煤炭将被清洁能源取代。
violation
n. 违犯；侵犯，妨碍
Driving without a seatbelt is a serious violation of traffic safety rules.
不系安全带驾驶是对交通安全规则的严重违反。
ideological
adj. 意识形态的
The debate over social media often reflects a deeper ideological divide between generations.
关于社交媒体的争论往往反映了代际之间更深层次的意识形态分歧。
calorie
n. 大卡；卡
Many students try to reduce their daily calorie intake by eating more vegetables and less fast food.
许多学生试图通过多吃蔬菜、少吃快餐来减少每日的卡路里摄入量。
analytical
adj. 分析的
She wrote an analytical essay that examined both sides of the debate.
她写了一篇分析性文章，探讨了这场辩论的双方观点。
preindustrial
adj. 工业化以前的
Before the preindustrial era, most families grew their own food and made their own clothes.
在前工业化时代之前，大多数家庭自己种植食物并缝制衣服。
scarcity
n. 缺乏，不足
The scarcity of clean water in many regions forces people to travel long distances daily.
许多地区清洁水源的稀缺迫使人们每天长途跋涉。
misled
v. (mislead过去式)误导
The advertisement misled many young people into buying products they did not need.
这则广告误导了许多年轻人购买他们并不需要的产品。
bureaucracy
n. 官僚主义，官僚作风；官僚机构；官僚制度；官僚
The new manager promised to cut through the bureaucracy and make decisions faster.
新经理承诺精简官僚程序，以便更快地做出决策。
recruiter
n. 招聘者
The recruiter asked me several questions about my past work experience.
招聘人员问了我几个关于我过去工作经验的问题。
endorsement
n. 支持
The famous athlete's endorsement of the product greatly increased its sales.
这位著名运动员对该产品的代言大大提高了其销量。
reunion
n. 重聚，团聚；聚会，联谊活动
The whole family gathered for a happy reunion during the Spring Festival holiday.
春节期间，全家人聚在一起，度过了一次快乐的团聚。
premium
adj. 高级的，优质的；售价高的 n. 保险金；额外费用，加付款；奖品，赠品；额外津贴
Consumers are willing to pay a premium for organic food.
消费者愿意为有机食品支付额外费用。
conformity
n. 一致
Teenagers often feel strong pressure to act in conformity with their friends.
青少年常常感到强烈的压力，要与朋友们保持一致。
inaction
n. 不作为
The government's inaction on climate change has worried many young people.
政府在气候变化问题上的不作为令许多年轻人感到担忧。
irony
n. 反话，冷嘲，嘲弄；具有讽刺意味的事
The great irony is that despite all his explanation nobody believed him.
最具有讽刺意味的情形是：尽管他竭力解释，可没一个人相信他。
monopolize
v. 垄断
The only grocery store in town tends to monopolize the local market and keep prices high.
镇上唯一的杂货店往往会垄断当地市场，并维持高价。
workload
n. 工作量
Heavy workloads often leave teachers with little time to rest or prepare lessons.
繁重的工作量常常使教师几乎没有时间休息或备课。
underrepresented
adj. 未被充分代表的
Women remain underrepresented in senior management positions at many large companies.
在许多大公司的高级管理职位中，女性仍然代表性不足。
regime
n. 政权，政体；制度
The new government promised to reform the tax regime to help small businesses grow.
新政府承诺改革税收制度，以帮助小企业成长。
bizarre
adj. 奇形怪状的，怪诞的
It seemed bizarre that the quiet student suddenly started singing in the middle of class.
那个安静的学生突然在课堂中间唱起歌来，显得很奇怪。
deforestation
n. 砍伐森林
Deforestation has destroyed the natural homes of countless animals and plants.
森林砍伐摧毁了无数动植物的自然家园。
exceptional
adj. 优越的，杰出的；例外的，独特的，异常的
Her performance in the final exam was truly exceptional compared to the rest of the class.
与班上其他人相比，她在期末考试中的表现确实非常出色。
upgrade
vt. 提升，使升级 n. 向上的斜坡
The airline offered to upgrade our seats because the flight was overbooked.
由于航班超售，航空公司提出为我们升级座位。
abnormally
adv. 不正常地
The unusually warm winter made the plants grow abnormally fast this year.
异常温暖的冬天使植物今年生长得异常迅速。
accidentally
adv. 偶然地，意外地
She accidentally deleted the important file while cleaning up her computer.
她在清理电脑时不小心删除了那个重要的文件。
legalize
v. 合法化
Some countries have legalized the use of marijuana for medical purposes.
一些国家已将大麻的医疗用途合法化。
dispensable
adj. 可有可无的
In today's job market, no employee should feel dispensable, no matter how small their role seems.
在如今的就业市场中，无论员工的角色看起来多么微不足道，都不应觉得自己是可有可无的。
certify
vt. 证明，证实；发证书给
The doctor certified that the patient was fit to work.
医生证明该病人适合工作。
insurer
n. 保险公司；承保人
The insurer agreed to pay for the damage caused by the storm.
保险公司同意赔偿暴风雨造成的损失。
obscurity
n. 默默无闻
After years of obscurity, the young writer finally published a novel that won wide praise.
在默默无闻多年之后，这位年轻作家终于出版了一部广受赞誉的小说。
dolphin
n. 海豚
The dolphin jumped high out of the water.
海豚高高地跃出水面。
severity
n. 严重性
Doctors were shocked by the severity of his injuries after the accident.
事故发生后，医生们对他伤势的严重程度感到震惊。
robbery
n. 抢劫
The police are investigating a robbery that took place at the bank yesterday.
警方正在调查昨天发生在银行的一起抢劫案。
inanimate
adj. 无生命的
The children treated the inanimate dolls as if they were alive.
孩子们把这些没有生命的玩偶当作活人一样对待。
baffle
v. 使挫折 n. 迷惑
The strange question baffled all the students.
这个奇怪的问题让所有学生都感到困惑。
authorities
n. 当局
Local authorities have promised to improve public transport in the coming year.
地方当局已承诺在来年改善公共交通。
chronicle
v. 记录
The diary chronicles her daily life in college.
这本日记记录了她的大学生活。
milestone
n. 里程碑
Graduation is an important milestone in every student's life.
毕业是每个学生人生中的重要里程碑。
unstable
adj. 不稳定的
His unstable internet connection made it hard to finish the online exam.
他不稳定的网络连接使他很难完成在线考试。
municipal
adj. 市的，市立的
The municipal government funded a new public library.
市政府资助了一座新公共图书馆。
ideologically
adv. 意识形态上地
The two parties are ideologically divided on how to reform the health care system.
两党在如何改革医疗体系上存在意识形态分歧。
robust
adj. 强壮的，健康的
The new teaching method proved robust enough to work well in large classes.
这种新的教学方法被证明足够稳健，在大班教学中也能很好地发挥作用。
reserved
adj. 保留意见的；矜持的
She seems reserved at first, but she becomes quite talkative once you know her well.
她起初显得矜持，但一旦你和她熟悉起来，她就会变得很健谈。
collide
vi. 碰撞，互撞；冲突，抵触
Two cars collided at the busy intersection yesterday.
两辆汽车昨天在繁忙的十字路口相撞。
industrious
adj. 勤劳的，勤奋的
She is an industrious student who spends hours studying in the library every day.
她是一个勤奋的学生，每天花好几个小时在图书馆学习。
prevalence
n. 流行，普遍
The prevalence of smart phones among college students has changed how they study and socialize.
智能手机在大学生中的普遍流行已经改变了他们学习和社交的方式。
appropriation
n. 据为己有，占有；挪用；拨款
Critics argued that the appropriation of local traditions by fashion brands often ignores their cultural meaning.
批评者认为，时尚品牌对当地传统的挪用往往忽视了其文化内涵。
injustice
n. 不公正
She spoke out against the injustice she had seen in the workplace.
她公开反对自己在职场中看到的不公正现象。
irrelevant
adj. 无关的
The teacher told us to leave out any irrelevant details when writing the summary.
老师告诉我们在写摘要时要省略任何不相关的细节。
registration
n. 注册，登记
Online registration for the new semester closes at the end of this week.
新学期的在线注册将于本周末截止。
deprivation
n. 剥夺，匮乏
Long-term sleep deprivation can seriously affect a student's memory and learning ability.
长期睡眠不足会严重影响学生的记忆力和学习能力。
designate
vt. 指派，委任；标出；把…定名为
The school designated a quiet room for students to study before exams.
学校指定了一间安静的房间供学生在考试前学习。
turtle
n. 海龟，玳瑁
The turtle slowly crossed the busy road.
那只龟慢慢地爬过了繁忙的马路。
expertise
n. 专门知识，专长
The team needs technical expertise to solve this problem.
团队需要专业知识来解决这个问题。
ventilate
vt. 使通风；把…公开，公开讨论
Open the windows to ventilate the room properly.
打开窗户，让房间充分通风。
trade-off
n. 权衡，交易
Choosing a major often involves a trade-off between personal interest and future income.
选择专业往往需要在个人兴趣和未来收入之间做出权衡。
duplication
n. 复制品
Careful proofreading can prevent the duplication of information in the final report.
仔细校对可以防止最终报告中的信息重复。
abandonment
n. 放弃
The sudden abandonment of the project left many workers without jobs.
项目的突然放弃使许多工人失去了工作。
turbulent
adj. 动荡的，混乱的；汹涌的，狂暴的
The small boat struggled through the turbulent waters during the storm.
暴风雨中，小船在汹涌的水域中艰难前行。
expel
vt. 把…除名，把…开除；驱逐，赶走，放逐；排出，喷出
The government expelled the foreign diplomats last week.
政府上周驱逐了那些外国外交官。
unprecedented
adj. 史无前例的
The campus festival drew unprecedented crowds this year.
今年的校园节吸引了前所未有的人群。
outperform
v. 胜过
Studies show that students who sleep well tend to outperform those who stay up late.
研究表明，睡眠充足的学生往往比熬夜的学生表现更出色。
modernize
v. 现代化
The company plans to modernize its old factories by installing new machines.
公司计划通过安装新机器来实现旧工厂的现代化。
interactive
adj. 〔人与计算机程序、电视系统等〕交互的，互动的；合作的；相互交流的
The new language app makes learning fun through interactive games and short quizzes.
这款新的语言应用通过互动游戏和短测验让学习变得有趣。
successively

未来的学生应该在决定上哪所大学之前参观一下校园。

新图书馆明亮宽敞，所以学生们喜欢在那里学习。

学校的辅导员帮助我选课，并在考试前帮我缓解压力。

cropland

政府正在保护耕地，以确保不断增长的人口有足够的粮食。
relieved

听说考试取消了，她感到如释重负。

创办新企业是一项需要仔细规划的高风险事业。

公司资金管理不善导致了严重的财务问题。

她决定一周内断开与社交媒体的联系，以便专心学习。

她在截止日期前花了整个下午修改她的论文。

她断言这项新政策从长远来看会使学生受益。
breezy

我们在宁静的河岸边享受了一个微风习习的午后散步。
presidency

她写了一本书，讲述在那位年轻领导人担任总统期间她的那些岁月。
quota

每位员工每月都有必须完成的任务数量定额。

她完成了两年的实践培训后获得了教学资格证书。

他在会议上傲慢的态度让其他人很难分享自己的想法。

定期锻炼能大大提升你一整天的情绪和精力水平。
reflective

会议结束后，她陷入沉思，想着自己本可以说些什么不同的话。

学生们经常在小组项目中合作，以分享想法并更快地完成工作。

从高中到大学的过渡对许多学生来说可能具有挑战性。

地震后，这座旧图书馆受到的损坏很小。

这名官员因收受当地商人的贿赂而被逮捕。

桌子后面的电线缠得太乱了，她无法拔掉电脑的插头。

在访问这些机密文件之前，你需要获得经理的书面授权。

人文教育鼓励学生深入思考价值观和社会问题。

这位年轻律师在辩论的最后一轮遇到了一位强劲的对手。

睡眠不足会对你的记忆力和学业表现产生不利影响。

这些发现证明了早期教育的价值。

只有少数享有特权的人才能负担得起住在如此昂贵的街区。

记者在撰写关于双方的文章时努力避免偏见。
lawsuit

该公司因未能保护客户的个人数据而面临一场代价高昂的诉讼。

社交媒体重新定义了年轻人与朋友交流的方式。

工程师在批准最终设计前仔细检查了每一项规格。

研究人员发现睡眠质量与学业成绩之间存在很强的相关性。

她注意到他的语气中有一丝细微的变化，表明他在担心。

如果火车满员了，你 alternatively 可以改乘公交车去机场。

老师注意到这名学生对课堂讨论的疏离，并试图提供帮助。

我们在酒店休息室里看杂志等房间，度过了整个下午。

那位空乘人员热心地帮助老年乘客找到了她的座位。

学校将派遣一辆公交车来接我们。

这两项实验在该系统中引发了同时发生的变化。

这片森林里的野生动植物得到了很好的保护。

如果不及时治疗，感染会迅速扩散并变得危险。

报纸有时会歪曲事实以吸引更多读者。

她决定不吃早饭，直接去图书馆。

这所大学通过提供免费培训和小额资助来鼓励学生创业。

随着故事展开，我们逐渐明白主人公为什么离开了家。

这项新政策遭到了批评者的猛烈攻击。

每位股东都有权在公司的年度大会上投票。

这两个软件系统之间的不兼容导致项目严重延误。

航天飞机将补给品运送到空间站。

暴风雨过后，工人们清理了碎片。

这个沿海小镇每年夏天吸引成千上万的游客。

雇主因年龄而歧视员工是违法的。

她花了好几周才重新适应新城市的生活。

许多年轻毕业生设定了起初看似不可能、但通过稳步努力便能实现的远大目标。

外面的噪音终于超过了阈值，把宿舍里的每个人都吵醒了。
uneven

她每天早上参加田径运动，以保持健康和精力充沛。

misery
n. 痛苦，苦恼，苦难；悲惨的境遇，贫苦
The constant noise from the construction site caused great misery for the residents nearby.
建筑工地持续不断的噪音给附近的居民带来了极大的痛苦。
torment
n. 痛苦 v. 折磨
The constant noise from the construction site tormented the students during their final exams.
建筑工地持续不断的噪音在期末考试期间折磨着学生们。
thrash
v. 痛打，鞭打，打
The losing team was thrashed by ten points in front of their own fans.
失利的那支队伍在自己球迷面前以十分之差惨败。
likeness
n. 同样；类似，相似
The portrait showed a striking likeness of the old man's gentle smile.
这幅肖像生动地展现了那位老人温和笑容的相似之处。
accessory
n. 附件，零件，配件；装饰品；同谋，帮凶，包庇犯
This accessory improves the performance of the device.
这个配件能提升该设备的性能。
customary
adj. 习惯上的，惯常的，合乎习俗的
It is customary to remove your shoes before entering a traditional Japanese home.
进入传统的日本家庭前脱鞋是一种习俗。
ordinarily
adv. 通常，大概
She ordinarily walks to the office, but today she took the bus because of the rain.
她通常步行去办公室，但今天因为下雨她坐了公交车。
hydrocarbon
n. 烃，碳氢化合物
Burning hydrocarbons such as gasoline releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
燃烧汽油等碳氢化合物会向大气中释放二氧化碳。
resignation
n. 听从，屈从，顺从
After months of stress, she handed in her resignation and started looking for a new job.
在经历了数月的压力之后，她递交了辞呈，开始寻找新工作。
blacksmith
n. 铁匠，锻工
The blacksmith heated the iron and shaped it into a sharp tool.
铁匠把铁加热，然后把它锻造成一件锋利的工具。
ferrous
adj. 铁的；亚铁的
The old factory recycled ferrous metals such as iron and steel from discarded machines.
这家旧工厂从废弃机器中回收铁和钢等黑色金属。
adjoin
v. 贴近，毗连；靠近
A small garden adjoins the old library, offering students a quiet place to read.
一个小花园紧挨着旧图书馆，为学生提供了一个安静的阅读场所。
hop
vi. 单足跳跃，单足跳行；齐足跳跃，齐足跳行 vt. 跳上 n. 蹦跳；短程航行
The rabbit hops across the grassy field quickly.
兔子迅速跳过草地。
modulate
v. 调整，调节（声音）
Doctors can modulate the dose to reduce side effects for each patient.
医生可以调节剂量以减轻每位患者的副作用。
mischief
n. 调皮，捣蛋，胡闹
The children got into mischief while their parents were busy cooking dinner.
父母忙着做晚饭时，孩子们捣起乱来。
questionnaire
n. 调查表，征求意见表
Students were asked to complete a questionnaire about their study habits before the exam.
学生们在考试前被要求填写一份关于学习习惯的问卷。
sweetness
n. 甜蜜，芬芳；愉悦，美好
The sweetness of the ripe peaches reminded her of summer afternoons at her grandmother's house.
熟透的桃子那甜美的滋味让她想起了在祖母家度过的夏日午后。
catholic
adj. 天主教的；普遍的，广泛的 n. 天主教徒
The Catholic community built a new church downtown.
天主教社区在市中心建了一座新教堂。
astronomy
n. 天文学
She became interested in astronomy after watching a documentary about the stars.
她看完一部关于星星的纪录片后对天文学产生了兴趣。
purify
vt. 使纯净，提纯；使纯洁
The new filter can purify tap water and remove most harmful chemicals.
这种新型过滤器可以净化自来水并去除大多数有害化学物质。
peculiarity
n. 特性，独特性；怪癖
One peculiarity of this old house is its narrow staircase.
这座老房子的一处奇特之处是它的楼梯很窄。
earthenware
n. 陶器
She kept the fresh milk cool in a large earthenware jug on the kitchen floor.
她把新鲜牛奶放在厨房地上的一个大陶罐里冷藏。
outlaw
n. 逃犯，歹徒
The town feared the outlaw and his gang.
镇上的人害怕那个法外之徒和他的团伙。
wade
v. 趟（河），跋涉
We had to wade through the shallow river to reach the other side.
我们不得不蹚过那条浅浅的河才能到达对岸。
probe
v. 探索，查究，调查；用探针探查，探测 n. 探针，探测器；探索，调查
The committee decided to probe the causes of the sudden decline in sales.
委员会决定调查销售额突然下降的原因。
charcoal
n. 炭，木炭；生物炭
We grilled the meat over hot charcoal until it was golden brown.
我们用炽热的木炭烤肉，直到它变成金黄色。
greed
n. 贪心，贪婪
His greed for money ruined their friendship.
他对金钱的贪婪毁掉了他们的友谊。
moss
n. 苔藓，地衣
After the rain, thick green moss covered the old stone wall in the garden.
雨后，厚厚的绿色苔藓覆盖了花园里的旧石墙。
pedal
vi. 踩踏板，骑车 n. 踏板，踏脚 vt. 脚蹬，踩动…的踏板
She pressed the pedal to slow the car down.
她踩下踏板让车减速。
thereof
adv. 它的，其；由此
The contract was signed, and the terms thereof must be followed by both parties.
合同已签署，双方必须遵守其条款。
trivial
adj. 琐碎的，不重要的
Do not waste your time arguing about such trivial matters before the exam.
考试前不要浪费时间争论这些琐碎的事情。
what
adj. 所…的
What factors explain the recent rise in inequality?
什么因素解释了近期不平等现象的加剧？
deform
v. 损坏…的形状
The intense heat caused the plastic bottle to deform and lose its original shape.
高温使塑料瓶变形，失去了原来的形状。
deformation
n. 损坏；变形；畸形
The metal bar showed slight deformation after being exposed to intense heat.
金属棒在暴露于高温后出现了轻微的变形。
fringe
adj. 附加的 n. 刘海；饰以流苏的边；边缘，外围 vt. 成为…的边缘
These groups remain on the fringe of society.
这些群体仍处于社会的边缘。
scrap
n. 碎片，碎屑；废金属；残羹剩饭；少量，点滴 vt. 废弃，抛弃
He wrote the address on a scrap of paper and put it in his pocket.
他把地址写在一小片纸上，然后放进了口袋。
random
n. 随机 adj. 随机的
The teacher chose a random student from the class to answer the question.
老师从班上随机选了一名学生来回答问题。
shorthand
n. 速记，速记法
The reporter used shorthand to record the interview quickly.
记者用速记快速记录采访内容。
loosely
adv. 松松地，松散地
The rules were loosely enforced, so students often arrived late without any punishment.
这些规定执行得较为宽松，所以学生经常迟到却不受任何惩罚。
hiss
n. 嘶嘶声 v. 嘶嘶作声
The snake gave a loud hiss when we walked too close to the bushes.
当我们走得太靠近灌木丛时，那条蛇发出了响亮的嘶嘶声。
rip
v. 扯破，撕坏 n. 裂口，裂缝
The storm ripped a huge hole in the roof.
暴风雨在屋顶上撕开了一个大洞。
velvet
adj. 丝绒制的；柔软光滑的
The queen wore a velvet gown at the ceremony.
女王在仪式上穿了一件天鹅绒长袍。
treasurer
n. 司库，财务主管
The treasurer keeps careful records of every donation the club receives.
财务主管仔细记录俱乐部收到的每一笔捐款。
exposition
n. 说明，解释；展览会，博览会
The science exposition attracted many curious students.
科学博览会吸引了许多好奇的学生。
preach
vi. 布道，说教 vt. 宣讲，布道；竭力鼓吹，宣传
Parents should not preach to their children constantly.
父母不应总是对孩子进行说教。
momentary
adj. 瞬息间的，片刻的
She felt a momentary flash of doubt before signing the contract.
在签署合同之前，她感到一阵短暂的疑虑。
couch
n. 睡椅，长沙发椅
After a long day at work, he fell asleep on the couch while watching television.
工作了一整天后，他看电视时在沙发上睡着了。
slumber
n. 睡眠；沉睡状态
The baby fell into a deep slumber as soon as the music started.
音乐一响起，婴儿便陷入了沉睡。
buffalo
n. 水牛；水陆坦克
The buffalo drinks water by the river.
水牛在河边喝水。
hydraulic
adj. 水力的；水力学的
The hydraulic system failed, so the workers could not lift the heavy machine.
液压系统失灵了，所以工人们无法抬起那台沉重的机器。
watery
adj. 充满水的；与水有关的；湿的；（食物、饮料等）味淡的
The soup tasted watery because the cook added too much water to it.
这汤尝起来很淡，因为厨师往里面加了太多的水。
rinse
v. 冲洗；嗽（口）
Please rinse the vegetables thoroughly before you cook them.
烹饪前请把蔬菜彻底冲洗干净。
wrestle
n. 摔交；斗争，搏斗
The two boys wrestle on the grass after school.
放学后两个男孩在草地上摔跤。
numerical
adj. 数字的；用数字表示的；数值的
The researchers compared the numerical results from both experiments before drawing any conclusions.
研究人员在得出结论之前比较了两个实验的数值结果。
harp
n. 竖琴；天琴座
She learned to play the harp when she was only six years old.
她年仅六岁时就学会了弹竖琴。
terminology
n. 术语学，术语
Students must learn the technical terminology before they can read research papers.
学生在阅读研究论文之前必须学会专业术语。
proficient
adj. 熟练的，精通的
She is proficient in three foreign languages.
她熟练掌握三门外语。
proficiency
n. 熟练，精通
She practiced speaking English every day to improve her proficiency before the exam.
为了在考试前提高熟练度，她每天练习说英语。
dependant
n. 受赡养者
As a dependant, she could not sign the rental agreement without her parents.
作为受抚养人，没有父母她无法签署租房协议。
miser
n. 守财奴，吝啬鬼
The old miser refused to spend a single coin on his own meals.
那个老守财奴不肯为自己的饭菜花一枚硬币。
trolley
n. 手推车；有轨电车
He pushed a trolley full of goods through the supermarket.
他推着一辆装满商品的手推车穿过超市。
handbook
n. 手册，便览，指南
This handbook explains how to use the new system.
这本手册说明了如何使用新系统。
adoption
n. 收养；采纳，采取
The adoption of new technology has greatly improved efficiency in many offices.
新技术的采用极大地提高了许多办公室的效率。
oath
n. 誓言，誓约；咒骂，诅咒语
The new citizens took an oath of loyalty.
新公民宣誓效忠。
vow
n. 誓言，誓约，许愿
They vowed to stay friends after graduation.
他们发誓毕业后仍做朋友。
wholesome
adj. 对健康有益的
Fresh vegetables provide wholesome food for growing children.
新鲜蔬菜为成长中的孩子提供有益健康的食物。
moderately
adv. 适度地，适中
She exercises moderately every day to stay healthy without feeling exhausted.
她每天适度锻炼以保持健康，而不会感到筋疲力尽。
fitting
adj. 适合的，恰当的 n. 设备，家具，日用器具；配件，附件，零件；试穿，试衣
It is fitting that the whole class celebrated her hard work with a small party.
全班同学办了一个小型聚会来庆祝她的努力，这是很合适的。
snob
n. 势利小人
He is a snob who ignores poor classmates.
他是个势利小人，瞧不起穷同学。
snobbish
adj. 势利的，谄上欺下的
His snobbish attitude toward the new employees made everyone in the office uncomfortable.
他对新员工势利的态度让办公室里的每个人都感到不舒服。
automate
v. 使自动化
The factory plans to automate its assembly line.
这家工厂计划将装配线自动化。
lengthen
v. 使延长，变长
The days lengthen quickly as spring approaches and the weather gets warmer.
随着春天的临近和天气变暖，白昼迅速变长。
shame
v. 使羞愧；玷辱
He felt deep shame for his dishonest actions.
他因不诚实的行为深感羞愧。
freshen
v. 使显得新鲜
She opened the window to freshen the air in the small classroom.
她打开窗户，让这间小教室里的空气变得清新。
moor
v. 使停泊；使固定
The small boat was tied safely to the moor near the quiet village.
小船被安全地系在安静村庄附近的停泊处。
lubricate
v. 使润滑，加润滑油
Oil helps lubricate the machine's moving parts.
机油有助于润滑机器的运动部件。
soften
v. 使软化，变温和
She added some milk to soften the strong taste of the coffee.
她加了一些牛奶来冲淡咖啡浓烈的味道。
tiresome
adj. 使人厌倦的，讨厌的
Waiting in long lines at the bank can be really tiresome.
在银行排长队等候可能真的很令人厌烦。
sorrowful
adj. 使人伤心的；悲伤的
She gave a sorrowful smile when she heard the disappointing news about her old friend.
听到关于老朋友的令人失望的消息时，她露出了悲伤的微笑。
subdue
v. 使屈服，征服
The firefighters worked for hours to subdue the flames before the wind could spread them.
消防员奋战数小时才压制住火焰，以防风势将其蔓延。
paralyse
v. 使麻痹，使瘫痪
The sudden power failure paralysed the entire subway system during rush hour.
突如其来的停电在高峰时段使整个地铁系统陷入瘫痪。
deafen
v. 使聋
The sudden explosion was loud enough to deafen anyone standing nearby.
那次突然的爆炸声大得足以让附近站着的任何人震聋。
terrify
vt. 使害怕，使惊吓
The loud thunder terrified the little girl, so she hid under the bed.
响亮的雷声吓坏了小女孩，于是她躲到了床底下。
insulate
vt. 使绝缘，使隔热，使隔音；隔离，使隔绝
Good policies can insulate the economy from external shocks.
良好的政策能使经济免受外部冲击的影响。
alternate
adj. 交替的，轮流的；间隔的 v. 轮流，交替
Warm and cold seasons alternate throughout the year.
一年中冷暖季节交替出现。
degrade
vt. 降低…的身份，有辱…的人格；使降解，使退化
Plastic bags degrade slowly in the soil.
塑料袋在土壤中降解缓慢。
mingle
vi. 混合起来，相混合；相交往，相往来 vt. 使混合，使相混
Students from different cultures mingle at the international conference.
来自不同文化的学生在国际会议上相互交往。
tangle
v. 缠结，乱作一团 n. 乱糟糟的一堆，混乱；复杂的问题；困惑
The legal tangle delayed the merger for months.
这场法律纠纷使合并推迟了数月。
sweeten
v. 使变甜，变甜
A little honey can sweeten the tea without adding too much sugar.
加一点蜂蜜可以让茶变甜，而不会添加太多糖。
thicken
v. 使变厚（或粗、密）
The sauce will thicken quickly once you add a little flour and stir.
一旦你加入一点面粉并搅拌，酱汁很快就会变稠。
jog
v. 慢跑（尤作为锻炼）
She jogs in the park every morning.
她每天早上在公园慢跑。
vector
n. 矢量；飞机航线
Scientists used a vector to insert the new gene into the plant cells.
科学家利用一种载体将新基因植入植物细胞中。
nourishment
n. 食物；营养（情况）
Children need proper nourishment to grow strong and stay healthy.
孩子们需要适当的营养才能强壮成长并保持健康。
pantry
n. 食品柜，餐具室
She keeps extra rice and canned food in the small pantry next to the kitchen.
她把多余的大米和罐头食品放在厨房旁边的小食品储藏室里。
experimentally
adv. 实验上，实验性地
The new teaching method was tested experimentally in several classrooms before being widely adopted.
这种新教学方法在被广泛采用之前，已在几个教室里进行了实验性测试。
experimentation
n. 实验；试验
Years of careful experimentation finally led the team to a surprising result.
多年的精心实验最终使团队得出了一个令人惊讶的结果。
execution
n. 死刑；实行，执行，履行；演奏，表演
The manager praised the team for the flawless execution of the new marketing plan.
经理称赞团队完美执行了新的营销计划。
quartz
n. 石英
The watch is powered by a small quartz crystal that keeps very accurate time.
这块手表由一块小型石英晶体驱动，走时非常精准。
graphite
n. 石墨，石墨电极
The teacher explained that graphite is a soft black substance used in pencils.
老师解释说，石墨是一种用于铅笔的柔软黑色物质。
whitewash
n. 石灰水 v. 粉饰
The village council tried to whitewash the scandal by hiding the report from the public.
村委会试图通过向公众隐瞒报告来掩盖这起丑闻。
limestone
n. 石灰石
The old church was built with limestone taken from a nearby quarry.
这座古老的教堂是用附近采石场开采的石灰岩建成的。
humidity
n. 湿度，潮湿，湿气
The high humidity in summer makes it hard to sleep without air conditioning.
夏天的高湿度让人不开空调就很难入睡。
handout
n. 施舍物，救济品
The teacher gave each student a handout summarizing the main points of the lecture.
老师给每个学生发了一份总结讲座要点的讲义。
verse
n. 诗，韵文；诗节
He wrote a short verse about the changing seasons.
他写了一首关于季节更替的短诗。
unemployment
n. 失业；失业人数
Rising unemployment has forced many young graduates to accept low-paying jobs.
不断上升的失业率迫使许多年轻毕业生接受低薪工作。
disgrace
n. 失宠，耻辱，丢脸
He felt deep disgrace after cheating on the final exam.
期末考试作弊后，他深感耻辱。
residual
adj. 剩余的；残余的
Some residual pain remained in his knee weeks after the injury.
受伤数周后，他的膝盖仍留有一些残余的疼痛。
remainder
n. 余下的部分，剩下的人数
After paying the rent, she saved the remainder of her salary for a trip.
付完房租后，她把剩下的工资存起来准备去旅行。
excel
v. 胜过，杰出
She excels at solving complex mathematical problems.
她擅长解决复杂的数学问题。
ecology
n. 生态学；个体生态学
Students should learn how human activities affect the ecology of rivers and forests.
学生应该了解人类活动如何影响河流和森林的生态。
producer
n. 生产者；舞台监督
The producer of the documentary spent two years filming in remote villages.
这部纪录片的制片人在偏远的村庄拍摄了两年。
hoist
vt. 举起，升起，吊起 n. 起重器械；举起，升起，吊起
Workers hoist the heavy equipment onto the platform.
工人们把重型设备吊升到平台上。
kidney
n. 肾，腰子
Regular exercise helps maintain healthy kidney function.
规律运动有助于维持健康的肾功能。
deliberately
adv. 故意地；审慎地
She deliberately left the meeting early to avoid answering difficult questions.
她故意提前离开会议，以避免回答棘手的问题。
censor
v. 审查，检查
The school decided to censor the student newspaper.
学校决定审查学生报纸。
shrine
n. 神殿，神龛，圣祠
Every spring, many families visit the small shrine near the river to pray for good luck.
每年春天，许多家庭都会去河边的小神殿祈求好运。
trench
n. 深沟；壕沟，战壕
The soldiers dug a deep trench to protect themselves from enemy fire.
士兵们挖了一条深战壕来保护自己免受敌人炮火的攻击。
photography
n. 摄影术
She took up photography as a hobby after buying her first camera.
她买了第一台相机后，就把摄影当作爱好。
conceive
vi. 构想出，设想；怀孕 vt. 想出，认为；怀
It is hard to conceive how people lived without electricity a century ago.
很难想象一个世纪前没有电人们是如何生活的。
serpent
n. 蛇（尤指大蛇或毒蛇）
The serpent slid silently through the tall grass before disappearing into the shadows.
那条蛇悄无声息地滑过高高的草丛，随后消失在阴影中。
extravagant
adj. 奢侈的；过度的，过分的，放肆的
She bought an extravagant dress for the party and never wore it again.
她为聚会买了一条昂贵的裙子，却再也没有穿过。
maiden
n. 少女，未婚女子
The maiden sang softly by the river.
少女在河边轻声歌唱。
scorch
v. 烧焦；枯萎
The hot sun scorched the grass in the garden during the long summer.
在漫长的夏天里，烈日把花园里的草晒焦了。
tradesman
n. 商人，店主；手艺人
The tradesman repaired our kitchen sink quickly and charged a fair price.
那位工匠很快修好了我们的厨房水槽，而且收费合理。
trader
n. 商人
The trader bought goods at a low price and sold them in the market.
这个商人以低价买入货物，然后在市场上出售。
dealer
n. 商人；毒品贩；发牌者
The dealer offered a fair price for the used car.
经销商为这辆二手车给出了公道的价格。
ware
n. 物品；商品，货物
The shop sells handmade ceramic ware.
这家店出售手工陶瓷制品。
merchandise
n. 商品，货物
The store sells a wide range of merchandise.
这家商店出售各种各样的商品。
underwear
n. 衫衣，内衣，贴身衣
She packed clean underwear for the trip.
她为旅行打包了干净的内衣。
sift
v. 筛，过滤
She spent the afternoon sifting through old photos to find one for the family album.
她花了一下午翻找旧照片，想为家庭相册挑一张。
shark
n. 鲨鱼；勒索者，诈骗者，放高利贷的人
The lifeguard warned swimmers that a shark had been seen near the beach.
救生员警告游泳者，有人在海滩附近看到了一条鲨鱼。
gravel
n. 砂跞；砂砾层；结石
The workers spread gravel over the muddy path to make it easier to walk on.
工人们在泥泞的小路上铺上碎石，以便行走更方便。
sardine
n. 沙丁鱼
The small boat was so crowded that we felt like sardines packed in a tin.
小船太拥挤了，我们感觉就像装在罐头里的沙丁鱼。
uproar
n. 骚动，扰乱；喧嚣
The sudden change in policy caused a huge uproar among the students.
政策的突然变化在学生中引起了巨大的骚动。
prose
n. 散文
Her prose is clear and elegant, making even complex ideas easy to understand.
她的散文清晰优雅，使即使复杂的思想也易于理解。
stroll
n. 散步，溜达，闲逛
They strolled through the quiet campus after class.
课后他们在安静的校园里漫步。
triangular
adj. 三角的；三者间的
The engineer designed a triangular support to make the bridge stronger.
工程师设计了一个三角形支架来使桥梁更加坚固。
tolerant
adj. 容忍的；有耐力的
Young people should be tolerant of different opinions when discussing social issues online.
年轻人在网上讨论社会问题时应该对不同的观点持宽容态度。
merciful
adj. 仁慈的，宽大的
The judge was merciful and gave the young man a lighter sentence.
法官很仁慈，给了这个年轻人较轻的判决。
hostage
n. 人质
The bank robbers kept three employees as hostages during the long standoff with police.
在与警方的长时间对峙中，银行劫匪将三名员工作为人质扣押。
thermal
adj. 热的，由热造成的；保暖的
Thermal energy can be converted into electricity efficiently.
热能可以高效地转化为电能。
tropic
n. 回归线；热带地区
The tropic climate supports a wide variety of species.
热带气候支持着种类繁多的物种。
combustion
n. 燃烧
The engine burns fuel through a process called combustion, which releases heat and energy.
发动机通过称为燃烧的过程消耗燃料，释放出热量和能量。
whisker
n. 髯，连鬓胡子
The cat twitched its whiskers and stared curiously at the moving toy.
那只猫抽动胡须，好奇地盯着移动的玩具。
positively
adv. 确定的，断然
Regular exercise can positively affect both your mood and your overall health.
经常锻炼可以对你的情绪和整体健康产生积极的影响。
quantify
vt. 确定…的数量，量化
Researchers struggle to quantify the social impact of new technologies.
研究人员难以量化新技术的社会影响。
deficiency
n. 缺乏，不足；缺点，缺陷
A deficiency of vitamin C can lead to serious health problems.
缺乏维生素C会导致严重的健康问题。
extract
vt. 取出，抽出；采掘，提炼，榨取；获得，索取；摘录 n. 摘录，选段；提出物，精，汁
Scientists can extract useful chemicals from plants to make new medicines.
科学家能从植物中提取有用的化学物质来制造新药。
crank
n. 曲柄 v. 用曲柄转动
He had to crank the old machine by hand because the motor was broken.
因为马达坏了，他不得不手动转动那台旧机器。
dissipate
vi. 消散，消失 vt. 使消散，使消失；浪费，挥霍
The morning fog began to dissipate as the sun rose over the quiet town.
随着太阳在安静的小镇上空升起，晨雾开始消散。
spherical
adj. 球形的，球面的
The earth is not perfectly spherical but slightly flattened at the poles.
地球并非完美的球形，而是在两极处略微扁平。
jupiter
n. 木星；丘庇特
Through a small telescope, Jupiter appears as a bright disk with faint bands.
通过小型望远镜，木星呈现为一个带有淡淡条纹的明亮圆盘。
plea
n. 恳求，请求；抗辩，答辩，辩护；借口，托辞
The workers made a plea for higher wages.
工人们恳求提高工资。
petition
v. 请愿，正式请求 n. 请愿书，申请书；诉状
Citizens signed a petition to protect the local park.
市民签署请愿书以保护当地公园。
sight
n. 景象；名胜，风景
The mountain village is a beautiful sight in the early morning light.
这座山村在清晨的阳光下是一道美丽的景色。
mosque
n. 清真寺
The old mosque near the market attracts many visitors every Friday afternoon.
市场附近那座古老的清真寺每周五下午都吸引许多游客。
cleanliness
n. 清洁
The school encourages students to maintain cleanliness in the classrooms and hallways.
学校鼓励学生保持教室和走廊的清洁。
inclination
n. 倾斜，点头；斜坡
She has a strong inclination to avoid risky decisions when she is under pressure.
她在压力之下有强烈的倾向去避免冒险的决定。
rap
vi. 说唱 vt. 敲击，急敲；突然厉声说出；责备，训斥 n. 敲击，急敲
Young artists often express social issues through rap.
年轻艺术家常通过说唱音乐表达社会问题。
rash
adj. 轻率的，鲁莽的 n. 疹，皮疹；爆发的一连串
The rash spread quickly across his arms.
疹子迅速蔓延到他的双臂上。
agreeable
adj. 令人愉快的，惬意的；同意的，乐意的
The new roommate is friendly and agreeable, so everyone enjoys living with him.
新室友友好又随和，所以大家都喜欢和他一起住。
hardy
adj. 能吃苦耐劳的，坚强的；耐寒的
These hardy plants survive cold winters easily.
这些耐寒的植物能轻松度过寒冬。
compulsory
adj. 必须做的，强制性的；必修的
Education is compulsory for all children in this country.
在这个国家，所有儿童都必须接受义务教育。
constraint
n. 限制，束缚，约束
Many students find the strict rules and time limits a real constraint on their creativity.
许多学生认为严格的规则和时间限制对他们的创造力是一种真正的束缚。
mighty
adj. 强大的；巨大的
The mighty river flows through several countries before reaching the sea.
这条浩荡的河流穿过好几个国家，最后流入大海。
thoughtless
adj. 欠考虑的；自私的
It was thoughtless of him to leave without saying goodbye to anyone.
他没有跟任何人告别就离开了，这样做很欠考虑。
denounce
vt. 谴责，指责；告发
Critics denounced the policy as harmful to the economy.
批评者谴责该政策对经济有害。
pious
adj. 虔诚的；虔奉宗教的
She remained pious throughout her life, attending church every Sunday without fail.
她一生都很虔诚，每个星期天都去教堂，从未间断。
predecessor
n. 前任，前辈；原有事物，前身
The new manager changed several rules that her predecessor had introduced.
新经理改变了她的前任所引入的几条规则。
visa
n. 签证
She applied for a student visa months before her flight to London.
她在飞往伦敦的几个月前就申请了学生签证。
modesty
n. 谦逊；端庄
Her modesty prevented her from mentioning her own achievements during the interview.
她的谦逊使她在面试中没有提及自己的成就。
kilowatt
n. 千瓦（特）
This new air conditioner uses less than one kilowatt of electricity per hour.
这台新空调每小时耗电不到一千瓦。
pertinent
adj. 恰当的；有关的
The professor asked several pertinent questions about the data before accepting our conclusion.
教授在接受我们的结论之前，就数据提出了几个相关问题。
apt
adj. 易于…的，有…倾向的；恰当的，适宜的；聪明的，反应敏捷的
She is apt to forget her keys when she leaves in a hurry.
她匆忙离开时容易忘带钥匙。
utensil
n. 器皿，用具
Please wash the cooking utensils thoroughly before you use them again.
再次使用前，请把炊具彻底清洗干净。
maple
n. 槭树，枫树
The leaves of the maple tree turn bright red every autumn.
每年秋天，枫树的叶子都会变成鲜红色。
follower
n. 信徒，追随者
She has thousands of followers on social media who enjoy her daily posts.
她在社交媒体上有数千名粉丝，他们喜欢她每天发布的帖子。
siren
n. 汽笛，警报器
The fire truck's siren woke the whole neighborhood late at night.
深夜，消防车的警报器吵醒了整个街区的居民。
motorway
n. 汽车道，快车路
The motorway was busy during the holiday.
假期期间高速公路上车流繁忙。
hitherto
adv. 迄今，到目前为止
Hitherto, we have learned a lot of words.
到目前为止, 我们已经学了很多单词。
barometer
n. 气压计，睛雨表
Grades are often a barometer of student effort.
成绩往往是学生努力程度的晴雨表。
pant
v. 气喘
He wore loose pants for the long journey.
长途旅行时他穿着宽松的裤子。
jack
n. 起重器；传动装置
He used a jack to lift the car.
他用千斤顶把汽车顶了起来。
enlighten
v. 启发，开导；启蒙
The teacher's explanation helped to enlighten students about the causes of climate change.
老师的讲解帮助学生们了解了气候变化的成因。
implore
v. 乞求，恳求，哀求
She implored her professor to give her one more day to finish the essay.
她恳求教授多给她一天时间完成这篇论文。
knight
n. 骑士，武士；爵士
The brave knight rode a white horse.
勇敢的骑士骑着一匹白马。
marvel
n. 奇迹；惊奇 v. 惊奇
The students marvel at the starry night sky.
学生们惊叹于繁星点点的夜空。
periodical
adj. 周期的；定期的；时而发生的 n. 期刊
She visits the library every week to read the latest periodicals on science.
她每周都去图书馆阅读最新的科学期刊。
universally
adv. 普遍地，一般地
The new safety rules were universally accepted by all the workers in the factory.
这些新的安全规定被工厂里的所有工人普遍接受了。
bushel
n. 蒲式耳（容量单位）
The farmer harvested a hundred bushels of corn before the heavy rain arrived.
农民在暴雨来临前收获了一百蒲式耳的玉米。
raisin
n. 葡萄干
She added a handful of raisins to her oatmeal to make it sweeter.
她往燕麦粥里加了一把葡萄干，让它更甜一些。
fracture
v. 断裂，折断 n. 裂缝，裂痕；折断
The fracture in the bone required immediate medical attention.
骨骼的断裂需要立即就医。
persecute
v. 迫害，残害
Religious minorities were persecuted for their beliefs in some countries.
在一些国家，宗教少数群体因信仰而受到迫害。
flask
n. 长颈瓶，酒瓶，烧瓶
She poured the hot coffee into a small flask before leaving for the hike.
出发去徒步前，她把热咖啡倒进了一个小保温瓶里。
tack
n. 平头钉，大头钉；行动方向，方针 vt. 用平头钉钉；附加，增补
She used a tack to pin the notice on the board.
她用大头钉把通知钉在布告板上。
terrace
n. 排屋；地坪，草坪；
We enjoy tea on the terrace every evening.
我们每天傍晚在露台上喝茶。
tranquil
adj. 平静的；稳定的
The lake looks tranquil in the early morning.
清晨的湖面显得很宁静。
equilibrium
n. 平衡，均衡；均衡论
Prices adjust until the market reaches a new equilibrium.
价格会不断调整，直到市场达到新的均衡。
commonplace
adj. 普通的，平庸的 n. 寻常的事物，平庸的东西
Such complaints have become commonplace in modern society.
这类抱怨在现代社会已变得司空见惯。
barren
adj. 贫瘠的，荒芜的；不结果实的，不育的；无益的，没有结果的
Decades of overgrazing left the land barren and useless.
几十年的过度放牧使这片土地变得贫瘠无用。
bleach
v. 漂白，变白
She used bleach to whiten the stained shirt.
她用漂白剂把有污渍的衬衫漂白了。
flake
n. 片，薄片
She brushed a few white flakes of snow from her coat before entering the warm room.
她在进入温暖的房间之前，拂去了外套上的几片白色雪花。
deflection
n. 偏斜，歪斜；偏差
The engineer noticed a slight deflection of the beam under the heavy load.
工程师注意到横梁在重载下发生了轻微的偏转。
adjacent
adj. 毗连的；紧接着的
The library is adjacent to the main teaching building.
图书馆紧邻主教学楼。
cape
n. 斗篷，披肩；海角，岬
The cape protects her from the cold wind.
披肩为她抵御寒风。
foam
vi. 起泡沫，吐白沫 n. 泡沫；泡沫材料，泡沫状物
White foam covered the surface of the river near the factory.
白色的泡沫覆盖了工厂附近河水的表面。
bypass
n. 旁道，迂回道 vt. 绕过，绕…走；越过，置…于不顾
If we bypass the town, we will avoid the rush hour.
如果我们绕过市区, 我们就会避开高峰时间。
stagger
vi. 摇晃，蹒跚 vt. 使吃惊；使错开，使交错 n. 蹒跚，踉跄
The injured worker staggered toward the factory gate.
受伤的工人蹒跚着走向工厂大门。
faction
n. 派别，宗派，小集团
The party split into two rival factions.
该党分裂成了两个对立的小集团。
hover
vi. 翱翔；逗留在近旁，徘徊；彷徨，犹豫
The drone hovered above the field to collect data.
无人机在田野上方盘旋以收集数据。
drainage
n. 排水系统，下水道；排水，放水
Heavy rain caused the drainage system to overflow and flood the streets.
大雨导致排水系统溢流，淹没了街道。
reptile
n. 爬行动物
The snake is a reptile that sheds its skin several times a year.
蛇是一种爬行动物，一年会蜕皮好几次。
overhear
vt. 无意中听到，偷听到
She overheard their private conversation in the hallway.
她在走廊里偷听到了他们的私人谈话。
ohm
n. 欧姆
The resistance of this wire is exactly one ohm, according to the meter.
根据测量仪显示，这根导线的电阻正好是一欧姆。
feminine
adj. 女性的，女子的；女子气的
The study explores feminine leadership styles in modern firms.
该研究探讨现代企业中的女性领导风格。
waitress
n. 女侍者，女服务员
The waitress smiled warmly as she brought our coffee to the table.
女服务员微笑着把咖啡端到我们的桌上。
goddess
n. 女神
In the old story, the goddess of the moon protects the village every night.
在那个古老的故事里，月亮女神每晚都守护着村庄。
radiator
n. 暖气片；散热器
She turned up the radiator because the office felt cold this morning.
她把暖气片调高了，因为今天早上办公室感觉有点冷。
strive
vi. 努力，奋斗，力求
Students should strive to improve their English skills before taking the exam.
学生们应该在参加考试前努力提高他们的英语技能。
distortion
n. 歪曲；畸变
Excessive social media use can cause a serious distortion of how young people view reality.
过度使用社交媒体会严重扭曲年轻人对现实的看法。
shorten
v. 弄短，缩小，减少
The new highway will shorten the journey between the two cities by nearly an hour.
这条新高速公路将使两座城市之间的路程缩短近一个小时。
saturn
n. 土星
Saturn is the second largest planet in our solar system.
土星是我们太阳系中第二大的行星。
milky
adj. 牛奶的；乳白色的
The lake looked milky after heavy rain washed soil into the water.
大雨把泥土冲进水里后，湖水看起来呈乳白色。
wrench
vt. 猛拧，猛扭；挣脱；使扭伤 n. 痛苦，难受；猛扭，猛拉；扳手
The accident wrenched his shoulder and caused great pain.
事故猛扭了他的肩膀，造成了巨大的痛苦。
wring
v. 拧，挤，扭，榨
She had to wring the wet towel before hanging it on the line.
她不得不把湿毛巾拧干，然后再挂到绳子上。
nickel
n. 镍；五分镍币，五分钱
The battery requires nickel and other rare metals.
该电池需要镍和其他稀有金属。
practicable
adj. 能实行的；适用的
It is not practicable to finish the whole report in one afternoon.
在一个下午完成整份报告是不切实际的。
capability
n. 能力，才能
She has the capability to solve complex problems quickly and efficiently.
她有能力和效率地快速解决复杂问题。
tickle
vi. 发痒 vt. 使发痒；使高兴，逗乐 n. 痒
The soft grass tickled my bare feet.
柔软的草让我的光脚发痒。
pumpkin
n. 南瓜
My grandmother grows pumpkins in her garden.
我奶奶在她的花园里种南瓜。
baron
n. 男爵；贵族；巨商
The old baron owned most of the land around the village.
那位老男爵拥有村子周围的大部分土地。
sodium
n. 钠
Too much sodium in your diet is unhealthy.
饮食中钠摄入过多不利于健康。
intent
adj. 专心的，专注的；急切的 n. 意图，意向，目的
Her intent was clearly to help, but the plan failed badly.
她的意图显然是帮忙，但这个计划彻底失败了。
oyster
n. 牡蛎
She ordered a plate of fresh oysters and squeezed lemon juice over them.
她点了一盘新鲜的生蚝，并挤上柠檬汁。
magician
n. 魔法师；变戏法的人
